verificationSummary: Editor commit 7730a543fb572680144ed8252d9a20d28ce44b7d adds a bounded selected visual state for text-block descendants represented inside columns/table Preview surfaces. PaperPage now passes selectedNodeId into PaperBlock, and PaperBlock converts the selected editable text-block descendant into data-canvas-text-descendant-selected on the exact represented Preview target while preserving the owning composite surface data-node-id and leaving the parent data-selected false for child selection. editor.css gives selected child Preview targets a stable mini-object treatment: rgb(238, 249, 247) background, rgb(30, 111, 103) border color, a focus-colored inset/outer box-shadow, and pointer cursor without changing border width or preview item dimensions. The retained live Backend browser smoke now records selectedPreviewTextDescendantIds and reloadedSelectedPreviewTextDescendantIds as summary-left-text, previewHitTargetSelected and reloadedPreviewHitTargetSelected as true, and computed visual style values including backgroundColor rgb(238, 249, 247), borderTopColor rgb(30, 111, 103), and boxShadow containing rgb(30, 111, 103).
